identity.name: AI Video Director dependency acquisition
identity.version: 0.2.0-rc.3; Node >=22 / fresh pin 22.23.2; XML 5.10.1; HyperFrames 0.7.90 and 0.7.109; ChatCut 0.2.26

workflowRole.function: Agent reuses installed dependencies and acquires missing governed tools; verifies installation separately from authentication and production capability
workflowRole.output: local runtime, missing authoring Skill files, local receipt and explicit remaining Agent actions

software.license: Node MIT with bundled notices; fast-xml-parser MIT; HyperFrames Apache-2.0; Git GPL-2.0; FFmpeg depends on build; ChatCut service/plugin terms separate
software.commercialUse: per-component; ordinary dependency setup does not grant media rights
conditions: Download from official distributions or governed package managers. Preserve package notices. Do not redistribute tool binaries in this repository.
FFmpeg Homebrew/WinGet/apt builds can include GPL codecs; record the installed version/configuration in the project capability evidence.
ChatCut account, upload and credit authorizations remain separate.
No model acquisition merely to inspect a manuscript. Selected cutout follows its existing pinned-weight governance.

transitiveDependencies.auditStatus: existing XML lock pinned; HyperFrames npm transitive graph captured in local lockfile, not a full transitive legal audit
knownRestrictions: Native packages and browser retain their own notices; top-level version does not prove identical transitive resolution across first-time installs.
transitiveDependencies.distributionAction: Acquire on target device; do not commit binaries, models, caches or private receipts.

cost.licenseFee: per existing tool governance; no new paid service introduced
cost.credits: none for setup; ChatCut editing/ASR governed separately
cost.localCompute: download, extraction, npm/native installation and subsequent local smoke checks
cost.storage: Node/runtime/browser can require hundreds of MB; models only when selected
cost.maintenance: recheck changed versions and package-manager builds
cost.freeConclusion: No automatic paid purchase or API call; local downloads and compute are not costless resources.

access.account: ChatCut requires owner login; Node/FFmpeg/HyperFrames local downloads do not
access.apiKey: no new key requested by setup
access.network: official Node, npm registry, GitHub, browser distributor, OS package repositories
access.hardware: matching OS/architecture; Node >=22; practical media-render resources checked per host

rightsAndPrivacy.retention: tool caches and local receipts under local data directory; project artifacts stay outside Git
rightsAndPrivacy.outputRightsBoundary: Setup does not authorize portrait/voice use, media upload, new spending or publication.

stability.maturity: new Agent setup integration around existing governed tools
stability.reproducibility: Node archives SHA-256 pinned; Skill XML lock pinned; renderer version and authoring commit pinned; runtime transitive packages locked per host
knownFailureModes: Skill copy alone has no universal install hook
npx availability and plugin cache do not establish readiness
Node 20 fails selected HyperFrames engine requirement
Host tool list may require a new session after install/login
Package manager, OS permission, network, PATH and disk can block acquisition
PowerShell/Linux routes need native target-device validation
stability.vendorLockIn: ChatCut host authorization and session lifecycle; explicit local media handoff remains

evidence.scope: isolated Skill-only Node/XML acquisition; fresh HyperFrames/authoring/browser installation and actual 0.3s render/full decode; isolated ChatCut official plugin install/MCP registration and repeat reuse; 57 regression tests. Native fresh OS package managers, account OAuth, actual ASR/listening and full-video production not claimed.
evidence.hardware: macOS arm64; Windows/Linux command planning only
artifacts: PROJECT_STATE.json dependencySetup validation; private execution receipts outside Git

recommendation.allowedRole: Agent-owned first-use setup and stage-specific dependency repair within user-authorized editing workflow
recommendation.blockedRole: Claiming all machines or authenticated fresh accounts were tested; silently enabling a deliberately disabled plugin; optional model/paid service adoption; replacing existing working tool or Skill directories
recommendation.reason: User explicitly requires missing dependencies to be installed by Agent, existing ones reused, and only unavoidable actions delegated to user.
